scope: Bounded flat-line rebuilding trial; no spherical, seasonal or desktop selection
cohortSequence: Separate delayed common-face crossing at front .995
decision: Bounded rebuilding and delayed-wetting evidence only; fixed-time spatial RMS worsens, stock baselines have strict tiny-tail arithmetic refusal. No spherical/seasonal/default promotion.

contracts.state: Persist normalized high/low stocks; rounded mean projections do not replace them
contracts.boundaries: Exact instantaneous exterior flux at each old time; explicit Euler, not exact time-integrated forcing
contracts.refusal: No film, slope floor, support snapping, resized request or stock fallback; retain last accepted state
contracts.observations: All cells retained; roots discovered before truth; missing/nonunique/incomplete roots have null error
contracts.reproduction: Same build/environment; no cross-platform bitwise guarantee
contracts.replay: In-memory State clone and one subsequent accepted step, not serialized checkpoint support

verification.completeSuite: Entire npm test/all-native-target suite not rerun in this increment
verification.gui: Not run; no new desktop or spherical evolution claim
verification.priorFailures: Initial zero-residual assertion was too strong for floating ledger cancellation despite exact integer stock oracle; runtime tolerance unchanged. Delayed crossing uses separate contour regression bound; original bounds retained.
